parameter_description: Combine with a Program Change to select one of the unit's 1024 presets (bank * 128 + program)
notes: Unlike its predecessors the Axe-Fx III has no other fixed/default MIDI CC assignments; scene select scene/channel select tuner tempo tap wah/volume pedal control and every effect block's bypass are all mapped by the user to any CC number via the MIDI/Remote menu (see Modifiers and the Bypass page of the MIDI menu)
